messages.text: BL-1869 🎵 in progress — Swarm stamp-off of hotfix 51591aab4a - the throttle and briefing rework verdicts refresh BL-430's observatory before diagnosing - and owner of the BL-432 red it landed with: four of BL-432's five scenarios persist a degraded signal that the throttle CLI now recomputes over, so BL-432's step handler builds each diagnosis from a live 14-day window of closed tickets, and a sixth scenario pins that a stale signal left on disk no longer lowers the cap
